notes.subject: Merathayime
notes.rationale: מרתים dual ya מרה ('khohlehano'): lebitso la sesupo la Babilone — 'ba-khohlehang-babeli'; ba fetoleli bang ba bolela 'baetapele' (Wycliffe)

notes.subject: Pekode
notes.rationale: פקוד lebitso la sesupo le tshwanang le 'pekudah' (tlhokomeso/kahlolo) — papatleho ya Babilone

notes.subject: מרתים / פקוד
notes.rationale: Merathayime ('khohlehano e beli') le Pekode ('tlhokomeso/kahlolo') — maina a sesupo a sesosa thwii, a phelang ka bomong ho Sesotho

notes.subject: והחרם
notes.rationale: cherem ke thwaelo ya ho rulula ka botlalo bakeng sa Molimo; Sesotho 'rululohanye' e ka sehloohong e hlalosa sebopeho, e siea bokgoni ba sedikhuwa

notes.subject: to mabotho a Yisraele a kwelang Babilone
notes.rationale: Taello ya tobile: 'kena', 'senya', 'o ete' — Lebitso le bitsa mabotho

translation: Ho fathe lefatsheng la Merathayime, kena holim'a lona, le ho ba duleng Pekode: senya mme o rululohanye ka mora bona, ho bolela Yahwe, mme o ete tsohle tseo ke di laetseng hao.
